The '''Leisurenauts''' were a [[Band/Legends|band]] consisting of preprogrammed [[musician droid]]s of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era. They were installed in the [[Nexus Room]] [[Cantina/Legends|Cantina]] in [[Kaas City]], the capital of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] throneworld of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].

==History==
The Leisurenauts were a band installed in the [[Nexus Room]] [[Cantina/Legends|Cantina]] in [[Kaas City]]. Consisting of three droids, [[PK-1R]], [[4-4TM]] and [[E-B0W]], they were actively preforming in the cantina as early as [[3643 BBY]]. Patrons could activate the Leisurenauts by inputting [[Jukebox tokens|tokens]] into the cantina's [[Jukebox/Legends|jukebox]] and selecting a track for them to perform. The songs that the Leisurenauts had been programmed with included "[[Do the Holos Show Up on the Bill?]]," "[[In the Escape Pod]]," "[[Yesterday's Jawa]]" and "[[See You on the Dark Side]]."<ref name="SWTOR" />

Millennia after the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] expedition into the ruins of Kaas City excavated the still-intact Leisurenauts. The ancient droids were reactivated, and the music they had been programmed with was rediscovered. Some critics noted that these ancient instrumental pieces were soulless and reminiscent of [[lift-tube music]].<ref name="PartI" />
